name: io.github.Meet-Bhalodiya/newrelic-mcp
title: New Relic MCP Server
description: Secure, self-hosted New Relic observability and administration tools for MCP clients

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: New Relic user key. Create a dedicated least-privilege key.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_REGION
environmentVariables.description: New Relic data region: US, EU, or JP.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default account ID used when a tool omits accountId.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated account IDs this deployment may access.
